title: Park Dental Partners Expands Presence in Arizona with Addition of Ironwood Dental
summary: Minneapolis, MN – January 28, 2026 – Park Dental Partners, Inc. (NASDAQ: PARK) (the Company), a leading dental resource organization, announced that on January 23, 2026, Ironwood Dental, located in Tucson, Arizona, joins the Park Dental Partners network of affiliated dental practices.
